name: Nylon hedgehog cactus
desc: Nylon hedgehog cactus (Echinocereus viridiflorus): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 30 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Echinocereus viridiflorus is a species of cactus known by the common names nylon hedgehog cactus, green pitaya, and small-flowered hedgehog cactus.
